_about: Character movement values.
⚠ EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A GUESS. Not one has been measured against the
original. They are marked with _guess: true so the marking survives, per
MILESTONE_1.md section 3's rule: 'if a value is guessed rather than measured, it
gets a # GUESS comment in the JSON. No silent guesses.' The milestone's acceptance
checklist requires zero guesses remaining, so this file is a standing TODO.
WHAT IS ACTUALLY KNOWN (from the compiled AngelScript in android_game.bin, so it is
structure rather than numbers):
- The character is player-driven, NOT auto-walking: there is a ScreenPad /
SCREEN_PAD_BUTTON and a DIRECTION enum of MOVING_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT plus
setDirection. So a virtual d-pad drives it.
- char_feet.ent is a separate ground-contact sensor entity, with
ETHBeginContactCallback_char_feet / ETHEndContactCallback_char_feet. Ground
detection is a sensor, not a raycast.
- 'jumpForth' is the ONLY jump-related identifier in the whole binary, which is
weak evidence that jumping is limited or situational rather than a core verb.
Do not treat the jump values below as confirmed to even exist.
- killMainCharacter / isCharacterDead confirm an explicit death state.
TO RESOLVE: record the original and frame-step it (MILESTONE_1 7.6), or decode the
numeric constants out of android_game.bin. Until then, playtest feel means nothing.

movement._note: Pixel units, matching the original's coordinate space (1 unit = 1 px at scale 1).

_note: Ethanon runs Box2D with gravity (0, +10) in Box2D units at a 1/50 world scale
(docs/ethanon-formats.md section 10), i.e. +y down like Godot. The value below is
NOT that converted figure - it is a platformer-feel guess and will not match.
⚠ JUMP PROBABLY DOES NOT EXIST IN THE ORIGINAL. Two independent signals:
1. DECODED - the SCREEN_PAD_BUTTON enum contains exactly three members:
There is no jump button on the on-screen pad. (tools/asbc, docs/original-gameplay.md)
2. ABSENCE - 'jumpForth' is the only jump-related identifier in the whole binary.
3. OWNER-CONFIRMED (Ivan, 2026-08-05): the original had only move-left and
move-right buttons, plus screen taps to create portals. No jump.
NOW DISABLED. The portal mechanic exists, so the harness no longer needs a jump to
be playable. Kept as data rather than deleted so a debug build can re-enable it,
but it is OFF in normal play and a jump-based level solution proves nothing.
_coyote_note: Deliberately 0. A sweep of the binary for buffer/coyote identifiers returned ZERO
hits, which is real evidence the original has no such forgiveness system. This is
the one value here that is closer to measured than guessed - it is an argument
from absence, so still verify it.

body._note: Collision capsule. The original's char_feet.ent implies feet sit below the body.
